messages:
IncidentBot: P1 pager triggered for hosted-inference-prod — high 5xx rate and user-facing latency. Affected route: /v1/generate. Symptoms: 503 spikes, queue depth rising, some customers seeing failures. Paging @oncall.
Sara: on it, will triage. grabbing metrics and traces now.
Matt: I see the 5xx spike starting ~2134567600, spike to 12% errors for ~6m. CPU on pods fine, but the request queue metric (inference_queue_depth) jumps from 30->800. HPA target didn't trigger additional pods.
Anika: confirming, HPA events show no scale up: pod cpu/memory within thresholds. HPA uses `custom/external/queue_depth` metric — looks like metric provider reported stale values between 2134567400-2134567900.
Sara: initial mitigation: enabling fallback routing to dedicated-pool for high-latency requests (route-level policy). Doing a partial rollout to 10% to reduce pressure.
Leo: routing change applied via console — verifying. logs from ingress show ~10% of traffic shifted.
Jess: customers impacted: acme-app (partial), terra-ml (rate-limited), internal smoke tests failing. Notified account teams for acme-app.
Matt: sharing traces and logs: https://logs.redwood/trace/2134567890 and console snapshot: https://console.redwood/ops/2134567890
Anika: hypothesis list (start):
 - H1: metric exporter (metrics-proxy) delayed queue_depth updates => HPA didn't see demand. status: investigating.
 - H2: warmup latency for new GPU instances too high so pods spun up but not ready to serve KV caches => temporary rejects. status: investigating.
 - H3: serving runtime backpressure bug drops requests when queue > 512. status: low confidence.
Sara: grabbing recent kube events and `kubectl describe hpa inference-hpa -n prod`.
Sara: kube events show: `ScaledUp` not emitted; controller logs show: "skipping scale: metric value not available" around 2134567450.
Matt: metric provider logs: attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-01T12:10:45Z metrics-proxy ERROR failed to scrape external/queue_depth: timeout
2026-03-01T12:11:12Z metrics-proxy WARN scrape backlog growing, queue_size=650
2026-03-01T12:12:00Z metrics-proxy INFO scrape recovered
```
Anika: warmup traces show GPUs being provisioned but `kv_restore` times out on some nodes: restore latency 30-90s, normal ~2s. That would explain brief 503s while new pods aren't warm.
Leo: ops side — cloud provider reported imbalanced node allocation in region-us-west2 at 2134567300-2134568000; some GPU instances delayed provisioning by ~45-120s. Raising ticket.
Jess: customer impact update: acme-app reported request failures 12:10-12:18 local. They saw retries and degraded UX. Account notified.
Tim: short-term ops actions proposed:
 - A1: increase HPA fallback to scale on CPU as a stopgap (force more pods).
 - A2: extend routing fallback to 30% for 10m.
 - A3: add a synthetic warmup job to pre-populate KV cache on new pods.
Sara: applied A2. Traffic shift now 28% -> monitoring error rate.
OpsBot: Route change completed — 28% redirected to dedicated-pool. Reaction: :white_check_mark:.
Matt: after routing, 5xx rate dropped to 3% within 2 minutes; queue depth down to ~120. We still need RCA.
Anika: capturing timeline for RCA thread:
 - 2134567300: cloud reported provisioning delays (us-west2)
 - 2134567400: metrics-proxy scrape started failing intermittently
 - 2134567450: HPA controller logs: metric value not available
 - 2134567600: queue_depth spike -> request rejects begin
 - 2134567700: IncidentPager fires
 - 2134567800: routing fallback enabled (10%)
 - 2134567900: routing increased to 28% — errors abated

Sara: logging artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/incident/2134567890/logs.tar.gz
Matt: adding raw HPA events and metrics snapshot into thread gist: https://gist.github.com/matt/rca-2134567890
Anika: running targeted test to reproduce warmup delay locally with synthetic node slow attach. Will post results.
Leo: provider ticket: #CLOUD-24567 — delayed GPU attach confirmed, ETA unclear. Suggest we add fallback zones or pre-warm capacity for critical routes.
Jess: customer impact note for postmortem: acme-app experienced 12% request failures for 8m; SLA implications: possible credit. SDS to coordinate.
Sara: temporary post-incident mitigation checklist:
 - verify metrics-proxy retries/backoff
 - add HPA fallback metric to CPU when external metric missing (short-term)
 - add circuit-breaker to reject early when queue_depth > 1024 to fail fast client-side
 - scale dedicated-pool reserve for peak windows (ops)

Tim: assigning RCA leads: Matt (metrics path) and Anika (warmup/runtime). I'm the incident owner until handoff.
Jess: I'll draft customer comms and timeline.
Matt: status update in 20: will attach detailed metric timelines and proposed code changes for metrics-proxy.
Anika: reproducer attempt shows kv_restore failures when disk not ready — increasing init timeout prevents 503s in repro. patch candidate: `kv_restore_timeout=120s`.
Sara: handoff: I'm going offline in 25m, Tim will take primary oncall. Leaving notes in #inc-updates.
Tim: taking over. please ping me for urgent followups.
IncidentBot: Incident P1 annotated: mitigated (routing fallback), postmortem required.
Sara: thanks team — capture any stray hypotheses here. I'll compile a timeline and open RFC for: metrics-proxy hardening + prewarm strategy. :spiral_notepad:
